title: Croatian Rocket Soup
description: A hearty and flavorful soup made with Croatian bread, zesty vegetables, and peppery rocket.
instructions: In a large pot, melt butter over medium heat.
Add chopped zesty vegetables and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add diced Croatian bread and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in chopped rocket and heavy cream.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional rocket if desired.
